purpose: Supplement the existing 15 PoC source files with structured datasets suitable for NiFi ingestion and Iceberg curated tables.
notes: Candidate identity, roles, experience, education and skills are based on the submitted CV samples.
recruitment_status.csv contains synthetic demo lifecycle, score and compliance fields for dashboard/demo purposes.
policy_rules.csv contains selected structured policy facts derived from the submitted NSH/BNS/ENP policy documents.
Existing job-opening.xlsx and salary-policy.xlsx should remain source-of-truth structured inputs and can be ingested separately.
Raw PDFs/DOCX/XLSX should remain in S3 Raw; curated structured outputs should be written to Iceberg.
